info.title: AppstoreSpy API
info.description:
# Authentication The Appstorespy API uses API-KEY authentication.
If you do not have an API Key token, you can get it on your account page [https://appstorespy.com/account](https://appstorespy.com/account).
An API Key is required to be sent as part of every request in request header. ``` -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'API-KEY: ' ``` # Fields Use the fields parameter to specify which fields should be returned.
Example: ``` Request: fields=name,developer_name,ipd,downloads,... Response: {name: ..., developer_name: ..., ipd: ..., downloads: ..., ...} ``` Don`t use fields parameter if you need to get all fields.
# Sort When you use search, you can add a sort parameter. ``` Request: sort=ratingCount Response: [{name: app1, ratingCount: 4.2}, {name: app2, ratingCount: 4.4}, ...] ``` If you need DESC sorting add "-" before sort parametr. ``` Request: sort=-ratingCount Response: [{name: app2, ratingCount: 4.4}, {name: app1, ratingCount: 4.2}, ...] ``` # County & Language params ... # Status codes / Error codes * 200 OK. * 202 Accepted - The app was not present in our databases and has been submitted for crawling. If the app is available anywhere, it will be available soon. * 204 No Content - No data for requested country. * 403 Forbidden - Your access token is not valid. * 429 Too Many Requests - Your request rate is over the limit.

|active_countries|[]string|["US", "DE", "FR"] - List of countries where app is available (At least one country)|
|category|string|App Store category: "TRAVEL", "EDUCATION", "GAMES_STRATEGY", "LIFESTYLE" etc|
|review_count|ValueRange|{"gte": 1000, "lte": 5000}|
|rating_avg|ValueRange|{"gte": 3.5, "lte": 5.0}|
|with_ads|boolean|With Ads|

get.description:
Get Google Play apps daily installs.

`ipd` is derived from the cumulative install total: each increase is spread evenly across the elapsed days since the total last changed, so collection gaps and lagging reports are amortised rather than reported as a single-day spike. Values are raw and never negative.

Note: these are unsmoothed figures. AppstoreSpy's own charts additionally apply a moving average for readability, so a given day's value may differ from what the UI plots. This endpoint is the underlying data.
